source.name: Missouri DNR, Oil and Gas Wells (Missouri Geological Survey map service)

at_risk.definition: Missouri DNR status Shut in, Temporarily Abandoned (Idle) or Inactive, with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked yet: the DNR map service is the only operator source found so far. All 4,816 USGS Missouri wells match by API number.
notes: API_NUMBER is county + well (e.g. 037-20070); prefix 24 is added. Only wells not under confidentiality are published.
